heading: Admin
lede: Changes go live on the public site as soon as you save them.
dragInstructions: Press space to pick this item up. Use the up and down arrow keys to move it, space again to drop it, or escape to cancel.
reorderHint: Drag the handle on the left, or use the arrows, to reorder. The new order saves by itself.
unsavedOrder: The new order is not saved yet.
orderFailed: Couldn’t save the new order. It’s back the way it was. Check your connection and try again.
networkError: the connection dropped. Check your internet and try again.
toggleFailed: Couldn’t change that. Check your connection and try again.
deleteFailed: Couldn’t delete that. Nothing was removed. Check your connection and try again.
saveFailed: We couldn’t save. Your changes are still here. Check your connection and try again.

series.title: Voices
series.sub: Choose who tells the story, in what order, and how each voice looks. Chapters are one tab over.
